tailoring.headline: Business Analyst / E-Commerce Consultant | SAP Commerce Cloud & Enterprise Integration
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional E-Commerce Business Analyst and Consultant with 5+ years of experience delivering large enterprise platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for global brands like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise in requirements engineering, leading discovery workshops, formalizing functional specifications, stakeholder management, and orchestrating data and API integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. SAP Certified professional combining strong technical depth with rigorous agile delivery and stakeholder support.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Business Analyst / Consultant E-Commerce (H/F)
cover_en.hook: As an experienced E-Commerce Business Analyst and Techno-Functional Consultant with over 5 years of enterprise platform delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am thrilled by SQLI's leadership in digital transformation and DXP innovation. I bring deep expertise in translating complex business requirements into robust technical solutions for international stakeholders across the entire project lifecycle.

bullets.label: Requirements & Workshops
bullets.text: Led discovery sessions and stakeholder alignment with business teams, analysing requirements to formulate detailed user stories and functional specifications for global SAP Commerce Cloud implementations.

bullets.label: Integration & Architecture
bullets.text: Bridged business needs and technical execution by designing data flows and API integrations across PIM, ERP, and MDM platforms alongside international engineering teams.

bullets.label: Testing & Quality Assurance
bullets.text: Organized structured user acceptance testing (UAT) and internal validation campaigns to guarantee strict conformity between delivered solutions and business expectations.

bullets.label: Full Project Lifecycle
bullets.text: Supported international clients from pre-sales and implementation through to run and production support, ensuring seamless alignment between developers, project managers, and business stakeholders.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my techno-functional expertise can drive value for SQLI's clients.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at SQLI because of your recognized leadership in digital transformation and DXP innovation for major international brands. Your commitment to collaborative excellence within the TECH Society resonates strongly with my techno-functional background bridging business strategy and enterprise e-commerce engineering.
tailoring.motivation_short: Combining 5+ years of SAP Commerce consulting with strong stakeholder management, requirements engineering, and international project delivery to drive DXP success at SQLI.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years as a techno-functional SAP Commerce consultant and business analyst for global brands like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I'm very interested in SQLI's E-Commerce Consultant role. My profile is a strong match for your DXP team. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Business Analyst / Consultant E-Commerce (H/F) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application for the Business Analyst / Consultant E-Commerce (H/F) position at SQLI.

With over 5 years of professional experience delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms for global leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise spanning requirements engineering, stakeholder management, functional specifications, and end-to-end project lifecycle support.

My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your DXP team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
